habitat.en: Wetlands provide an important habitat for birds, insects, and many other animals.
habitat.zh: 濕地為鳥類、昆蟲和許多其他動物提供重要棲地。

habitual.en: Habitual late arrivals can make group projects harder to organize effectively.
habitual.zh: 習慣性遲到會讓小組專題更難有效安排。

hacker.en: The article explains how an ethical hacker can help improve computer security.
hacker.zh: 這篇文章說明道德駭客如何協助改善電腦安全。

hail.en: Small pieces of hail covered the playground after the sudden afternoon storm.
hail.zh: 午後突來的暴風雨後，小塊冰雹覆蓋了操場。

haircut.en: He got a haircut before the school ceremony on Friday afternoon.
haircut.zh: 他在星期五下午的學校典禮前剪了頭髮。

hairdresser.en: The hairdresser asked what style would be practical for everyday school life.
hairdresser.zh: 髮型師詢問哪種髮型最適合日常校園生活。

hallway.en: Students displayed their science posters along the hallway outside the library.
hallway.zh: 學生把科學海報展示在圖書館外的走廊上。

halt.en: Heavy rain forced the outdoor rehearsal to halt for nearly an hour.
halt.zh: 大雨迫使戶外彩排暫停將近一小時。

ham.en: The sandwich contained ham, lettuce, tomato, and a slice of cheese.
ham.zh: 這份三明治裡有火腿、生菜、番茄和一片起司。

hamburger.en: She ordered a hamburger with salad during the class trip lunch break.
hamburger.zh: 班級旅行午餐休息時，她點了一個漢堡配沙拉。

hammer.en: The workshop keeps each hammer in a labeled drawer after class.
hammer.zh: 工作坊下課後會把每支鐵鎚收在有標籤的抽屜裡。

hamper.en: Poor communication can hamper progress even when every team member works hard.
hamper.zh: 即使每位組員都很努力，溝通不良仍可能妨礙進度。

handful.en: Only a handful of students stayed after class to finish the display.
handful.zh: 只有少數學生下課後留下來完成展示。

handicap.en: The old rule created an unnecessary handicap for smaller teams in the contest.
handicap.zh: 舊規則讓較小的隊伍在比賽中承受不必要的不利條件。

handicraft.en: The cultural fair included a handicraft workshop using paper and natural materials.
handicraft.zh: 文化市集包含一場使用紙張與天然材料的手工藝工作坊。

handkerchief.en: A clean handkerchief was folded neatly inside the costume pocket.
handkerchief.zh: 一條乾淨的手帕整齊摺好放在戲服口袋裡。

handwriting.en: Clear handwriting makes written answers easier for teachers to read accurately.
handwriting.zh: 清楚的筆跡能讓老師更容易正確閱讀作答內容。

handy.en: A small notebook is handy for recording new vocabulary during class.
handy.zh: 小筆記本很方便，可以在上課時記下新單字。

hang.en: Please hang your wet raincoat near the door before entering the classroom.
hang.zh: 進教室前，請把濕雨衣掛在門邊。

hanger.en: Each costume was placed on a hanger with the actor's name attached.
hanger.zh: 每套戲服都掛在衣架上，並附上演員姓名。

harass.en: School rules clearly state that students must never harass or threaten others.
harass.zh: 校規明確規定學生不得騷擾或威脅他人。

harassment.en: The school provides several ways for students to report harassment safely.
harassment.zh: 學校提供多種方式，讓學生能安全通報騷擾事件。

harbor.en: Fishing boats returned to the harbor before the weather became worse.
harbor.zh: 天氣惡化前，漁船回到了港口。

harden.en: The clay will harden after it dries completely in a warm room.
harden.zh: 黏土在溫暖房間裡完全乾燥後會變硬。

hardship.en: The novel follows a family that stays hopeful despite years of hardship.
hardship.zh: 這本小說描寫一個家庭即使多年面臨困境仍保持希望。

homework.en: She finished her homework before joining the online study group that evening.
homework.zh: 她當晚加入線上讀書會前先完成了作業。

honest.en: An honest answer is more useful than pretending to understand the question.
honest.zh: 誠實的回答比假裝懂題目更有幫助。

honesty.en: The teacher praised his honesty when he admitted making a mistake.
honesty.zh: 他承認犯錯時，老師肯定了他的誠實。

honey.en: A spoonful of honey gave the plain yogurt a mild sweetness.
honey.zh: 一匙蜂蜜讓原味優格多了一點溫和甜味。

honeymoon.en: The travel article described a quiet island popular with honeymoon visitors.
honeymoon.zh: 這篇旅遊文章介紹一座很受蜜月旅客歡迎的安靜島嶼。

honor.en: It was an honor for the student team to represent their school.
honor.zh: 能代表學校參賽，對學生團隊來說是一項榮譽。

honorable.en: The judges praised her honorable decision to report the scoring error.
honorable.zh: 評審稱讚她主動回報計分錯誤的正直決定。

honorary.en: The university awarded an honorary degree to the respected scientist.
honorary.zh: 大學授予那位受敬重的科學家榮譽學位。

hook.en: The teacher used a question as a hook to begin the lesson.
hook.zh: 老師用一個問題作為引子開始這堂課。

hop.en: The small bird made one quick hop across the garden path.
hop.zh: 那隻小鳥在花園小徑上快速跳了一下。

hopeful.en: The team remained hopeful after seeing steady improvement during practice.
hopeful.zh: 看到練習成果穩定進步後，團隊仍然充滿希望。

horizon.en: Dark clouds appeared on the horizon shortly before the evening storm.
horizon.zh: 傍晚暴風雨前不久，地平線上出現了烏雲。

horizontal.en: Draw a horizontal line across the graph at the value of ten.
horizontal.zh: 請在圖表數值十的位置畫一條水平線。

hormone.en: The biology lesson explained how a hormone can carry signals through the body.
hormone.zh: 生物課說明荷爾蒙如何在體內傳遞訊號。

horn.en: The driver used the horn briefly to warn people near the crossing.
horn.zh: 駕駛短按喇叭，提醒平交道附近的人注意。

horrible.en: The weather was horrible, so the field trip moved to an indoor museum.
horrible.zh: 天氣很糟，因此戶外校外教學改到室內博物館。

horrify.en: The documentary did not aim to horrify viewers but to explain the disaster calmly.
horrify.zh: 這部紀錄片不是要嚇壞觀眾，而是冷靜說明那場災難。

horror.en: She prefers mystery stories to horror because they feel less intense.
horror.zh: 她比較喜歡推理故事而不是恐怖故事，因為感覺沒那麼刺激。

horse.en: A horse stood quietly beside the fence while visitors took photos.
horse.zh: 遊客拍照時，一匹馬安靜站在圍欄旁。

hose.en: The gardener used a hose to water the plants behind the greenhouse.
hose.zh: 園丁用水管澆溫室後方的植物。

hospitable.en: The host family was hospitable and helped the exchange student feel comfortable.
hospitable.zh: 接待家庭非常好客，讓交換學生感到自在。

hospitality.en: The visitors appreciated the warm hospitality they received during the cultural exchange.
hospitality.zh: 訪客很感謝文化交流期間受到的熱情款待。

hospitalize.en: Doctors may hospitalize a patient when close medical observation is necessary.
hospitalize.zh: 需要密切醫療觀察時，醫師可能會安排病人住院。

host.en: Our class will host a small exhibition for parents next Friday.
host.zh: 我們班下週五將舉辦一場給家長參觀的小型展覽。

hostage.en: The history lesson discussed how negotiators worked to protect each hostage.
hostage.zh: 歷史課討論談判人員如何努力保護每一名人質。

hostel.en: The student hostel has a shared kitchen and a quiet reading room.
hostel.zh: 學生旅舍有共用廚房和安靜的閱覽室。

hostess.en: The hostess welcomed each guest and showed them to their seats.
hostess.zh: 女主人迎接每位賓客並帶他們入座。

hostile.en: A hostile tone can make a simple disagreement much harder to resolve.
hostile.zh: 敵對的語氣會讓簡單的意見不合更難解決。

hostility.en: The teacher encouraged calm discussion instead of hostility during the debate.
hostility.zh: 老師鼓勵辯論時冷靜討論，而不是彼此敵視。

hourly.en: The weather station records temperature changes on an hourly basis.
hourly.zh: 氣象站每小時記錄一次溫度變化。

housekeeper.en: The housekeeper left fresh towels outside the guest room that morning.
housekeeper.zh: 那天早上，房務人員把乾淨毛巾放在客房外。

housewife.en: The novel portrays a housewife who later starts a small business.
housewife.zh: 這本小說描寫一位後來創業的家庭主婦。

housework.en: Sharing housework fairly gives everyone more time for other responsibilities.
housework.zh: 公平分擔家務能讓每個人有更多時間處理其他責任。

housing.en: The report examines how public transportation affects access to affordable housing.
housing.zh: 這份報告探討大眾運輸如何影響平價住宅的可及性。

hover.en: A small drone seemed to hover above the field during the demonstration.
hover.zh: 示範活動時，一架小型無人機似乎停在球場上空。

howl.en: We could hear a distant dog howl across the valley at night.
howl.zh: 夜裡我們能聽見遠處山谷另一側的狗嚎聲。

hug.en: She gave her grandmother a warm hug after returning from the trip.
hug.zh: 旅行回來後，她給了奶奶一個溫暖的擁抱。

hum.en: The air conditioner began to hum softly during the quiet exam.
hum.zh: 安靜的考試期間，冷氣開始發出輕微嗡嗡聲。

humanity.en: The exhibition explores how science has changed everyday life for humanity.
humanity.zh: 這場展覽探討科學如何改變全人類的日常生活。

humankind.en: The telescope helps scientists study questions about the future of humankind.
humankind.zh: 望遠鏡幫助科學家研究與人類未來有關的問題。

humble.en: Despite winning the contest, she remained humble and thanked her teammates.
humble.zh: 儘管贏得比賽，她仍保持謙虛並感謝隊友。

humid.en: The classroom felt humid after the rain because the windows were closed.
humid.zh: 下雨後因為窗戶關著，教室裡感覺很潮濕。

humidity.en: High humidity can make a warm afternoon feel even hotter outdoors.
humidity.zh: 高濕度會讓戶外溫暖的午後感覺更熱。

humiliate.en: Teachers should correct mistakes without trying to humiliate any student.
humiliate.zh: 老師應該糾正錯誤，但不應羞辱任何學生。

humorous.en: The speaker used a humorous story to make the difficult topic easier to follow.
humorous.zh: 講者用一個幽默故事讓困難主題更容易理解。

hunch.en: She had a hunch that the missing file had been saved elsewhere.
hunch.zh: 她直覺認為遺失的檔案可能被存到別處了。

hunter.en: The museum exhibit describes how an ancient hunter tracked animals for food.
hunter.zh: 博物館展覽介紹古代獵人如何追蹤動物以取得食物。

hurdle.en: Limited time was the biggest hurdle the team faced during the project.
hurdle.zh: 時間有限是團隊進行專題時面臨的最大障礙。

hurricane.en: The documentary explains how a hurricane gains energy over warm ocean water.
hurricane.zh: 這部紀錄片說明颶風如何從溫暖海水中獲得能量。

husband.en: Her husband joined the family dinner after finishing work that evening.
husband.zh: 她的丈夫當晚下班後加入家庭晚餐。

hush.en: A sudden hush fell over the room when the results appeared onscreen.
hush.zh: 結果出現在螢幕上時，房間突然安靜下來。

hut.en: The hikers rested beside a small hut near the mountain trail.
hut.zh: 健行者在山徑旁的一間小屋附近休息。

hybrid.en: The school adopted a hybrid schedule combining classroom lessons with online activities.
hybrid.zh: 學校採用混合式課表，結合實體課程與線上活動。

hydrogen.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element listed on the periodic table.
hydrogen.zh: 氫是元素週期表中最輕的元素。

hygiene.en: Good hygiene practices help keep shared classrooms clean and comfortable.
hygiene.zh: 良好的衛生習慣有助於維持共用教室乾淨舒適。

hypocrite.en: The character fears being called a hypocrite for ignoring his own advice.
hypocrite.zh: 這個角色擔心自己不遵守自己的建議而被稱為偽君子。

i.en: The pronoun i is normally written as a capital letter in English.
i.zh: 英文代名詞 i 通常要寫成大寫字母。

iceberg.en: Only part of an iceberg is visible above the ocean surface.
iceberg.zh: 冰山只有一部分會露在海面上。

icon.en: Tap the camera icon to open the photo section of the app.
icon.zh: 點一下相機圖示，就能開啟應用程式的照片區。

icy.en: The path became icy overnight, so visitors walked more carefully in the morning.
icy.zh: 小徑夜裡結冰，因此遊客早上走得更小心。

identical.en: The two samples looked identical but produced different results in the test.
identical.zh: 兩個樣本看起來完全相同，但測試結果不同。

identification.en: The field guide provides clear identification tips for common local birds.
identification.zh: 這本野外指南提供常見本地鳥類的清楚辨識技巧。

ideology.en: The history class compared how ideology influenced different political movements.
ideology.zh: 歷史課比較意識形態如何影響不同政治運動。

idiom.en: This English idiom makes more sense when you learn its cultural background.
idiom.zh: 了解文化背景後，這個英文慣用語會更容易理解。

idiot.en: Calling someone an idiot usually makes a disagreement more personal and less productive.
idiot.zh: 稱別人是笨蛋通常只會讓爭執更針對個人，也更難有結果。

idle.en: The old machine remained idle until the replacement part finally arrived.
idle.zh: 替換零件終於送到前，那台舊機器一直處於閒置狀態。

idol.en: The museum displayed a stone idol discovered near the ancient settlement.
idol.zh: 博物館展示一尊在古代聚落附近發現的石製偶像。

if.en: Use if to introduce a condition that may affect the final result.
if.zh: 可以使用 if 來引出可能影響最終結果的條件。

ignorance.en: The lesson shows how ignorance of basic facts can lead to poor decisions.
ignorance.zh: 這堂課說明缺乏基本事實知識可能導致不佳決策。

ignorant.en: It is better to ask questions than remain ignorant about an important issue.
ignorant.zh: 面對重要議題時，與其一無所知，不如主動提問。

illuminate.en: Street lamps illuminate the path so pedestrians can see clearly at night.
illuminate.zh: 路燈照亮道路，讓行人在夜間能清楚看見。

illusion.en: The mirror creates an illusion that makes the narrow room look larger.
illusion.zh: 鏡子製造出一種錯覺，讓狹窄房間看起來更大。

imaginary.en: The story follows an imaginary traveler exploring a city beneath the sea.
imaginary.zh: 這個故事描寫一位虛構旅人探索海底城市。

imagination.en: Creative writing gives students room to use imagination while practicing vocabulary.
imagination.zh: 創意寫作讓學生在練習單字時也能發揮想像力。

imaginative.en: Her imaginative solution turned ordinary recycled materials into a useful model.
imaginative.zh: 她富有想像力的解法把普通回收材料變成實用模型。

imitate.en: Young learners often imitate pronunciation they hear from teachers and recordings.
imitate.zh: 年輕學習者常會模仿從老師與錄音中聽到的發音。

imitation.en: The sculpture is an imitation of a much older work from another region.
imitation.zh: 這座雕塑是另一地區更古老作品的仿製品。

immense.en: The telescope revealed an immense cloud of gas surrounding the distant star.
immense.zh: 望遠鏡顯示遙遠恆星周圍有一大片巨大的氣體雲。

immigrant.en: The novel tells the story of an immigrant adapting to a new community.
immigrant.zh: 這本小說講述一位移民適應新社區的故事。

immigrate.en: Some families immigrate for work, education, safety, or other personal reasons.
immigrate.zh: 有些家庭因工作、教育、安全或其他個人原因移居他國。

immigration.en: The report examines how immigration can influence population and labor markets.
immigration.zh: 這份報告探討移民如何影響人口與勞動市場。

imminent.en: Dark clouds and strong winds suggested that a storm was imminent.
imminent.zh: 烏雲和強風顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

immune.en: The science article explains how the immune system responds to certain infections.
immune.zh: 這篇科學文章說明免疫系統如何對某些感染作出反應。
